commits.message:
feat(docs): run every migrated page's examples at build time (rich-docs-examples-xuu.812)

A pre-transform Vite plugin builds each page's examples into one program
(imports hoisted, the barrel-and-console prelude, the page's exampleContext,
blocks chained in nested scopes), type-checks it under the repo's strict
options, bundles it, and runs it once under the simulated process in a 75x24
truecolor terminal. Each block's bytes are held to its marker, decoded with
decodeAnsi and encoded as a light and a dark fragment under its fence.
Every failure fails the build at the page and line.

The marker vocabulary and the fence parser are one module, which
test/docs/code-blocks.ts now reads too, so a marked block stays in the
symbol-existence sweep. Every page with a TypeScript fence starts on
NOT_YET_MIGRATED, so the site is unchanged. tscTransform moved out of
vitest.config.ts so the bundler compiles src/ the same way.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
fix(host): no copy for a byte write without a newline; the harness writes bare newlines; the edge check waits for boot

fix(host): BrowserTerminalHost returns the carriage before every newline

xterm.js has no tty in front of it, so a bare newline moved down without
returning to column 0: every row a Console wrote started where the last one
ended, and every demo on the docs site drew as a staircase. The host now does
the tty's ONLCR translation for strings and bytes. The e2e gate only asked
whether a demo drew anything; it now also checks rich-viewport's rows start at
the panel's left border, which fails without this fix.

feat(ansi): decode ANSI bytes back into RichText (rich-docs-examples-xuu.9hv) (#169)

* feat(ansi): decode ANSI bytes back into RichText (rich-docs-examples-xuu.9hv)

A port of Rich's AnsiDecoder and Text.from_ansi: `decodeAnsi` for a whole
capture, `AnsiDecoder` for a stream read a line at a time. Colours decode to
the ColorSpec kind their escape names and are never resolved to RGB, so one
captured run exports correctly under a light theme and a dark one.

Two departures from Rich, both toward what a terminal shows: the link is
decoder state beside the SGR style, so an SGR reset inside a link leaves it
open; and a line ends only at \n, with the text after its last \r replacing
what came before, while codes before the \r still apply.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(ansi): a carriage return moves the cursor; every escape shape is dropped (rich-docs-examples-xuu.9hv)

\r returns to column 0 and later text overwrites, so CRLF and a trailing
\r keep their line. A private-marker CSI is not SGR; ECMA-48's
intermediates-plus-final escapes and an OSC cut off by the line are dropped.
Attribute on-codes derive from style.ts's ATTRIBUTE_SGR.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
